The Bürger-Uni was launched in 2015 with the aim of providing interested citizens with free access to scientific to pics. Since 2019\, the TUM Heilbronn Campus has been a partner of the even ts. Here\, emphasis is placed on making knowledge and science on current\, socially relevant topics\, which contain a strong scientific as well as s ocio-political relevance\, accessible to everyone.

\n\n

The event is aimed in particular at residents of Heilbronn and people of the region of all ages who are interested in scientific topics.

\n

BEGIN:VEVENT SUMMARY:CEO Leadership Series - Arthur Höld\, PUMA DTSTART:20261216T140000Z DTEND:20261216T160000Z DTSTAMP:20261009T134308Z UID:calendarize-ceo-leadership-series-arthur-hoeld-puma DESCRIPTION:The CEO Leadership Series is the flagship event series of the Technical University of Munich (TUM) and takes place at the Heilbronn camp us.\nThe goal of the event series is to connect top managers with students . The guests first hold a panel discussion and then respond to questions f rom the students. This gives students the opportunity to learn about the f ascinating life and work of successful and renowned managers\, and become familiar with different companies.\nThe CEO Leadership Series was inaugura ted by the former President of Germany and has featured executives from va rious companies\, including public firms that are part of the AEX 25 (Neth erlands)\, CAC 40 (France)\, DAX 40 (Germany)\, Dow Jones 30 (USA)\, and S MI 20 (Switzerland)\, among others. LOCATION:TV50\, Bildungscampus 14\, 74076 Heilbronn X-ALT-DESC;FMTTYPE=text/html:

The CEO Leadership Series is the flagship event series of the Technical University of Munich (TUM) and takes place a t the Heilbronn campus.

\n

The goal of the event series is to connect top managers with students. The guests first hold a panel discussion and then respond to questions from the students. This gives students the oppor tunity to learn about the fascinating life and work of successful and reno wned managers\, and become familiar with different companies.

\n

The CEO Leadership Series was inaugurated by the former President of Germany a nd has featured executives from various companies\, including public firms that are part of the AEX 25 (Netherlands)\, CAC 40 (France)\, DAX 40 (Ger many)\, Dow Jones 30 (USA)\, and SMI 20 (Switzerland)\, among others.

END:VEVENT

Join this self-paced course and get acquai nted with your new home in Heilbronn! Register here!

\n

Students will explore a comple tely digital self-study path\, which can be completed independently in pre paration for their stay. The module is designed for a total of 33-40 semes ter hours per week. \;

\n

Learning objectives:
The module ai ms to prepare foreign students for their stay in Germany and to encourage their anticipation. After completing the module\, students should:
1. Have a basic knowledge of German history and understand its influence on t oday's society.
2.Recognize and reflect on Germany's cultural charact eristics and values.
3.Have a basic understanding of German political systems and institutions.
4.Acquire specific knowledge about the Hei lbronn region and understand its historical\, cultural and economic signif icance.

\n

Contents:
Week 1: Political history of Europe\, Germa ny and Heilbronn - developments and influences
-German history from t he Middle Ages through the Weimar Republic to the present day
-Overvi ew of the political systems and developments in Europe and Germany
-I ntroduction to the European Union and its institutions
-Bonus materia l: Heilbronn's role in regional political contexts

\n


Week 2: E conomic development in Europe\, Germany and Heilbronn - changes and innova tions
-Industrial revolution in Europe and Germany
-Economic rec overy after the Second World War: Germany and Heilbronn
-Influence of European economic policy on local companies
-Bonus material: Heilbro nn as innovation and business location (e.g. viticulture\, mechanical engi neering)\, virtual excursion / presentation to a leading company in Heilbr onn

\n


Week 3: Social and cultural developments - social struct ures and cultural diversity
-Social movements in Europe and Germany-Integration and migration in Germany and cultural diversity
-Eme rgence and origin of German culture and values
-Bonus material: Local traditions and cultural events in Heilbronn

\n


Week 4: Technol ogical developments and innovations - in Europe\, Germany and Heilbronn
-Technological milestones in Europe and Germany
-Meaning of the "M ade in Germany" label and its origin and development
-Examples of suc cessful start-ups and innovation centers in Germany
-Bonus material: Heilbronn's role as a location for research and development and developmen ts over the last 10 years

\n


Week 5: Environmental and sustaina bility issues
-Environmental movements in Europe and Germany
-Le gislation to change sustainability activities in Europe and Germany
- Environmental facts about Europe and Germany compared to other countries ( e.g. China\, USA)
-Bonus material: Projects and programs to promote a nd protect the environment in Heilbronn

\n


Week 6: Legal framew ork and social norms
-Origin and overview of the German legal system< br />-European law and its impact on Germany
-Bonus material: Living together in Heilbronn

\n

Please note that TUM students do not receive ECTS credit for this course.
